lots.key_photo_findings: Confirmed from all 3 photos: flat stylised silhouette ships (black hulls, grey sails), one with funnel and side paddle wheel and red pennant, small sampans with flags, gradient blue to cream to yellow sky. Painting is naive and simplified, not detailed early Canton work. Back is a single stained board with a long horizontal crack, held by turn-buttons. Brass hanger is pierced and looks later or reapplied. No visible flaking of paint in the photos. The clean even gradient raises the possibility of 20th century decorative work.

lots.question_for_gowans: Is there any flaking or loss to the paint on the glass side (check under raking light)? Any labels, inscriptions or marks behind the back board? Dimensions? Is the glass original?
